fieldValues.statement: How we apply semantic engineering in practice: the semantic operations (SemanticOps) that let humans and AI make decisions well together. AI works at speed but lacks the bigger context, so work moves fast while it is experimental and stalls, stops and starts, and loses its connective tissue as it is woven into stable tools. The programme builds the layers of meaning, the SRS tools and the practice that let agents work inside that context, starting small and improving the clarity of the context with practice. It is run from its own records, and everything it does sits within one base domain, Semantic engineering in practice.
fieldValues.title: SemanticOps programme
